stability_assessment.cohort_method: 60 s bins by request submission; include complete request latency, including drain. All five bins retained. Percentiles interpolate at (n-1)q. These are diagnostic bins, not new acceptance thresholds.
limitations: Task counts use terminal input+output length. They do not establish how long live context remained above16K; final usage alone cannot timestamp the crossing.
C8 keeps all original 60 s warmups and 300 s formal phases; it is separate synthetic evidence, not a replacement for the task-based continuous-window conclusion in V1.5.
No new numerical definition of abnormal steep rise is imposed. Observed 4K/16K ratios and consecutive cohorts are disclosed for review, not automatically labelled pass or engine failure.
Budget length termination is explicit, not silent truncation. Raw stream checks and successful transport do not prove semantic answer completeness.

3.4.1.name: 有效算力效率 ≥50%
3.4.1.status: 历史原工况范围内达标；参考已重新核验
3.4.1.accepted_scope: Existing qualified M01 fixed200/out256, three synchronized uninstrumented repetitions per arm
3.4.1.reason: 已有独立合格参考，原脚本已重新核验算量、三轮计时及关键路径。B1保守效率下界达到50%；适用于原out256工况，不套用到新out8192运行。

3.4.2.name: 吞吐 ≥10%，TTFT/TPOT 各改善 ≥5%
3.4.2.status: 复用已封存配对重新核验：本次数值达标（原固定200题范围）
3.4.2.accepted_scope: This new prospectively frozen original200 pair; observed quality reported with original scorer
3.4.2.reason: 本次新配对吞吐变化100.95%，平均TTFT/TPOT改善51.73%/50.16%；两侧各200完整请求、零失败，正确数差-1/200。保留单次固定子集、长度终止与原服务协议，不推断统计质量等价。

3.4.3.name: 五数据集与16K稳定性
3.4.3.status: 固定五项执行完成；16K稳定性结论待复核
3.4.3.reason: 固定五项两臂均已完成，无失败或未返回请求。按输入+输出计实际16K覆盖：hle119/124、frontier44/40、swe4/4、terminal5/4、mmlu0/0（B0/B1）。裁判未决与准确率另列，不作为本项稳定性失败。独立C8两臂4K/16K正式窗口均完成：B1吞吐315.48→150.32 token/s，TTFT P99为2.622→9.827秒；16K五个连续提交区间的TTFT P99为10.131、6.396、5.213、3.958、3.152秒。尚需完成大纲所要求的真实任务实际16K区间、可比负载和尾时延的联合判读；有限终态长度计数或合成C8不能单独替代该结论。未将其判成已证实的引擎稳定性失败。

3.4.4.name: 单位token成本降低 ≥10%及高负载利用率改善
3.4.4.status: 复用已封存配对重新核验：本次数值达标（披露的同费率估算范围）
3.4.4.accepted_scope: This new pair, same reserved two cards and same fixed published price basis
3.4.4.reason: 本次两侧同费率估算单位输出token成本变化-50.24%；实际采样AI Core均值差+32.22个百分点。保留原费用范围、报价日期与利用率统计规则，不冒充实际账单。

price_basis.month_days_source: explicit analytical convention, not provider billing-cycle claim
price_basis.hardware_scope: Analogous 910B 64GB cloud instance, not proof of identical 910B2 subtype, host or purchase terms.
price_basis.policy: Apply the same rate and accounting scope to both arms; do not infer actual allocation from TP degree. Price is not selected to meet a reduction target.
price_basis.verification: Provider HTML fetched and price table plus billing-scope text inspected on 2026-10-29; web price-page fetch failures retained in conversation, terminal HTTP fetch succeeded.

metric_notes.throughput: Actual successful/completed output tokens divided by solver batch wall time. Judge traffic is separate.
metric_notes.tpot: Per-request (completion-first content token)/(output_tokens-1), equal-weight mean; output_tokens>1 only.
metric_notes.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; finite samples, not continuous stability.
metric_notes.quality: Original graders and planned denominators. Unresolved are nonsuccess, not confirmed incorrect; no statistical equivalence claim.
metric_notes.cost: Same fixed historical public analogous-machine rate; sample estimate, not actual invoice.
metric_notes.reuse: Every reused stage re-audited by the one-click runner; original source dates/controllers/failed parent statuses retained. No duplicated inference.

confirmed_interpretation.confirmation: 理论峰值就解释为同工况参考，否则不可能实现。
confirmed_interpretation.original_model_wording: 代表性7B–13B模型（与主责单位确定）
confirmed_interpretation.model_explanation_source: V1.5课题四35B调整及用户再次确认模型差异已解释；不重新设为阻塞项。

3.4.1.name: 单芯片有效算力
3.4.1.reason: 原文“理论峰值”按用户确认解释为同工况独立参考，模型沿用已确认35B。历史out256的B1保守下界约59.76%，未证明90%；下界距离不是实际效率差距，不反推真实效率必低90%，不套用于本轮完整回答或全五项。

3.4.2.name: 吞吐与时延
3.4.2.scenarios: 既定多轮对话、工具调用等典型场景；基准与可比资源沿用已确认配置。
3.4.2.evidence_summary: 按五项逐一核算；HLE吞吐/TTFT不满足，质量仍在复核
3.4.2.evidence_summary_en: Per-profile numbers; HLE throughput/TTFT miss; quality under review
3.4.2.reason: 沿用既定可比B0/B1与统一质量/服务要求。MMLU和两项trace等部分负载数值达到最终吞吐/时延门槛，但不能用这些通过覆盖HLE退化或未解决的质量/Schema问题；不拼接不同负载的最优值。

3.4.3.name: 长上下文稳定性
3.4.3.requirement: ≥32K：吞吐平稳，TTFT/TPOT P95/P99稳定、无明显退化
3.4.3.requirement_en: ≥32K: stable throughput and TTFT/TPOT P95/P99, no obvious regression
3.4.3.evidence_summary: 本轮独立C8仅4K/16K；无可验收32K连续窗口
3.4.3.evidence_summary_en: Current C8 covers4K/16K; no qualified32K continuous window
3.4.3.reason: 16K里程碑窗口不证明32K最终目标；偶发总上下文长度也不能代替连续吞吐曲线与P95/P99尾延迟稳定性证据。保留原文定性要求，不自行增加尾延迟阈值。

3.4.4.name: 单位token成本与利用率
3.4.4.comparator: 国际主流开源框架；本项目按已确认B0配对及可比条件复核。
3.4.4.requirement: 单位token成本降低 ≥30%；多租户场景维持较高利用率
3.4.4.requirement_en: Unit token cost reduced ≥30%; high utilization with multiple tenants
3.4.4.evidence_summary: MMLU同费率估算约降低50.24%；多租户证据未完成
3.4.4.evidence_summary_en: MMLU equal-rate estimate about−50.24%; multi-tenant evidence incomplete
3.4.4.reason: 保留已确认国际主流开源框架B0与可比条件，费用为历史公开报价同费率估算，不是本机账单。单服务高负载利用率不能自动证明多租户要求；未发明“较高利用率”的数值门槛。

project_final_assessment.limits: 已确认同工况参考和35B模型解释；最终目标单独展示，里程碑通过不等于最终验收通过。

blockers: MMLU质量优势未复现、HLE首批延迟和裁判未决问题仍在复核；4例开发诊断不替代正式验收。

revision.reason: Separate answer quality from V1.5 stability; count total context and expose continuous C8 tails. Original measurements and v1 remain unchanged.
